title: Focused Magicks
problem: Multiplies 30% by 10%×missing: 0% with a full party, 3% per missing creature.
notes: In-game test: Focused Magicks: cast a damage spell on enemies with different Defense; the ignored Defense follows each target's Defense. Fix: H | 2026-10-26 realign (text is the contract): text claims "ignore 30% of enemies' Defense, plus 10% more for each creature missing". H: bc_SpellDamage L164-L171: Def -= Def x (0.3 + 0.1 x missing) instead of (0.3 x Def) x (0.1 x missing). vs bugged: stronger.

release_notes.intended: Ethereal spell gems ignore 30% of enemies' Defense, plus 10% for each creature missing from your party.
release_notes.actual: The game multiplied the parts together, so with a full party the gems ignored no Defense.
release_notes.fix: Now the parts add up: 30% plus 10% per missing creature.
